params.name: agent_id
params.description: ID of the agent whose artifacts to list.

params.name: session_id
params.description: Filter to artifacts produced within a specific session.

params.name: search_query
params.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the artifact filename.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Sort order for results. Defaults to `newest`.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of artifacts to return per page. Clamped to 1–100.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a prior call as `next_cursor`.

items.docs: List artifacts (files) produced by an agent. Optionally scope to a specific session, search by filename, sort, and paginate.

params.name: artifact_id
params.description: ID of the artifact to download.

params.name: version_id
params.description: Specific version of the artifact to download. Defaults to the latest version when omitted.

items.docs: Returns a signed download URL for an artifact, plus its filename, media type, and size. Follow `download_url` to fetch the file bytes.
